selection_rule: Balanced deployment score: 40% Test R2, 15% RMSE, 10% MAE, 20% CV R2 mean, 7.5% CV variability, and 7.5% train-test gap.
selection_justification: CatBoost ranked first using the balanced deployment score (99.09/100). It combines held-out accuracy, prediction error, cross-validation performance, cross-validation stability and the train-test gap.
